sources.name: impeccable
sources.cli_version_note: Checkout git HEAD is 3.6.1 but npm `latest` IS 3.6.0 (verified via `npm view impeccable version`), so 3.6.1 is unreleased and there is NO upgrade to apply. A clean `npm install -g impeccable` re-run exits 0 and still yields 3.6.0. Not drift, and nothing to action. Verified 3.6.0 runs non-degraded.
sources.notes: Repo ships a prebuilt copy of itself for ~15 harnesses as hidden dot-dirs (75MB). Prune list keeps .agent (canonical build, holds detector rules), .impeccable, skill/ (source), cli/. Pruned footprint ~12MB.
